ai_summary: Ceinsys Tech Limited has secured a significant domestic Letter of Award from Rite Water Solutions (India) Limited, valued at approximately Rs. 28.17 Crores (excluding GST), for the design, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of critical automation equipment for 125 electrical substations. This material contract, to be executed over 24 months with a two-year warranty, is expected to substantially boost the company's order book and revenue visibility in the power infrastructure sector, with no apparent red flags regarding related party involvement or promoter interest.
